title: Research the moment a card is dropped
summary: The board could start a headless Claude run when a card lands in Research, so the report appears without opening a session.
source: Offered while designing the Research column; the owner chose research at the next session instead (D-009).
checkpoint: Revisit if waiting for the next session turns out to be too slow.

title: Archive old diary entries
summary: When record.json grows past a few hundred entries, move the oldest into a yearly archive file that the digest skips and the page still shows.
checkpoint: The digest no longer fits in one screen, or the session-start hook becomes slow.
